definitions.gloss: stupid-looking face; idiotic expression; dopey face
definitions.explanation: A face or facial expression that looks foolish, absent-minded, or vacant. Used as an insult or in humorous self-deprecation.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}するな。
⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}った→映る：12964_utsuru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}って→笑う：00685_warau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I couldn't help laughing at my own stupid face reflected in the mirror.

examples.japanese: ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧{間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮|と}られた→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: Someone took a photo of my dopey face sleeping with my mouth open.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧ (fool, idiot) + {面|づら} (face — rough/informal word). A rude but commonly heard expression. The suffix {面|づら} is a coarser alternative to ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ and adds a derogatory or humorous tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a stupid face
- {間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{晒|さら}す→晒す：04609_sarasu⟧: to show one's stupid face (to the public)
- {間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk around looking like an idiot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧: fool, idiot — the base word, describing someone who misses the timing or point
- とぼけた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: blank/feigned-ignorance face — similar look but implies deliberateness
- ⟦{能面|のうめん}→能面：27782_noumen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: Noh-mask-like face — expressionless rather than foolish
